children: Huawei Technologies plans to launch two new AI chips in 2027 as it expands its AI computing business and seeks to compete with Nvidia
, rotating chairman David Wang said at the company’s Huawei Connect event in Shanghai.

Huawei plans to launch the 960DT in Q1 2027, followed by the Ascend 960PR in Q3, Wang said. The announcements mark an acceleration from Huawei’s previously disclosed roadmap for the Ascend 960, which had been scheduled for Q4 2027.

The company is also developing its UnifiedBus technology to connect large numbers of AI chips so they can work together as a single, larger computing system. Huawei has developed 11 chips around the technology for its supernode and supercluster systems, Wang said.

Huawei has shipped more than 1,000 supernode systems to more than 370 customers, Wang said. The systems combine multiple AI chips to handle computing tasks that require more processing power than a single chip can provide.

title: China's Huawei sets 2027 launch for new AI chips as it targets Nvidia
